hypothesis: Starting from the frozen-H3 D0-H32-s14000 action expert, adding clean-executed-action-conditioned future-H3 and future-state losses through the same ActionDiT blocks improves episode-disjoint action conditioning and fresh LIBERO success over an otherwise identical action-only continuation arm.
single_variable: The candidate adds a training-only clean-action consequence pass and future-H3/future-state/success-only-value heads over the same five D0 ActionDiT blocks; parent weights, H3 K/V, demo and rollout rows, flow noise, optimizer, sample order and deployed action forward are unchanged.

references.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models

architecture.upstream_code: WanTransformer3DModel with robot and future token tracks
architecture.local: Frozen INT8 MiniMax-H3 five-layer K/V plus pinned five-block DreamWAM ActionDiT D0 carrier
architecture.rationale: This is an H3 backbone port that preserves the proven deployable D0 action carrier; it is not an official FACT reproduction.

architecture.paper: Predicted action sees prefix and itself; clean action conditions future tracks; future tracks cannot enter predicted action
architecture.upstream_code: Teacher-forcing causal mask isolates A and lets SV/I see clean G
architecture.local: Deployed action is one unchanged forward; consequence targets use an isolated second pass of clean executed actions through the same blocks and are never model inputs
architecture.rationale: The local two-pass boundary is stricter than the mask for leakage: the action call has no future tensors, while auxiliary gradients still reach shared blocks.

architecture.paper: Flow-match future RGB, future state and value
architecture.upstream_code: Separate future_state/value decoders plus video decoder over shared Transformer tokens
architecture.local: Direct MSE heads predict train-split sample-weighted per-dimension z-scored 256D future H3 representation, normalized 8D proprioception and success-only progress value from pooled clean-action tokens
architecture.rationale: Frozen H3 representation replaces RGB decoding to keep 32-card work focused on action learning; direct heads are a smaller diagnostic port.

data.upstream_code: Selected RoboTwin LeRobot datasets with dense frame windows
data.local: 200779 episode-disjoint dense LIBERO train windows across all four suites
data.rationale: The project benchmark is LIBERO and keeps the existing D0 training contract.

data.paper: Executed action, observed future and failure-active metadata
data.upstream_code: Failure episodes skip action imitation but observed future/value train
data.local: C48 train has 15417 rows/400 episodes; validation has 3133 rows/80 disjoint episodes; actual replan8 actions concatenate to horizon32
data.rationale: Episode outcomes exist but causal failure onset does not; failure action and value are therefore masked, while observed future H3/state remain valid targets.

data.local: C48 train per episode min/median/mean/max rows are 9/50/38.5425/50; validation 12/50/39.1625/50
data.rationale: Rollout states are dense at every replan8 decision, not five snapshots, but are not every simulator frame.

action.paper: 48-step RobotWin delta action normalized with official stats
action.local: 32-step LIBERO absolute environment actions invert deployment gripper by dataset=(1-env)/2, then use exact D0 min-max normalization without clamp
action.rationale: This is the existing D0/LIBERO execution contract; actual valid actions pass exact environment-to-dataset round-trip at atol 1e-7.

objective.upstream_code: Action loss masked on failed episodes; future state/value on applicable rows
objective.local: Action-only and joint use identical shifted-flow action loss; joint adds train-only z-scored future-H3/state on all rows and value only on successful rows at normalized 1:0.1:0.04:0.04 weights
objective.rationale: Dividing all official relative weights by action weight 10 preserves D0 action LR scale; missing failure onset prohibits failure value supervision. The first mechanical v1 canary exposed raw projected-H3 RMS 66.85 and future loss about 4600, so it was retained as a scale-audit failure and replaced before long training by train-only z-scoring (identity e9d404b4edfb8cff0b9ebcc3570d330141b4c8cc67adc1befd0013c034eb2618).

optimization.paper: 150000 steps, batch32/GPU, action LR2e-4 and base LR2e-5
optimization.local: Planned per arm: 8 GPUs, each step 8 demo + 4 success rollout + 4 failure rollout, AdamW 5e-5, warmup500, 6000 steps, checkpoints every1000
optimization.rationale: The smaller already-trained D0 action expert uses a bounded paired continuation budget; a measured canary must determine wall clock before GO_LONG.

evaluation.paper: RoboTwin closed-loop success and optional best-of-N
evaluation.local: Episode-disjoint LIBERO validation first; only a paired winner runs wholly new trials33+ with identical initial states, noise, replan8 and success predicate
evaluation.rationale: LIBERO is the target benchmark and C54 states are not reused for the final effect claim.
